reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, nice catch that `--maxtokens` was stored and then ignored by four backends.

Checked at `fd80476`: `openai`, `groq`, `litellm` and `bedrockmantle` now read `GetMaxTokens()` in `Configure` and send it in `GetCompletion`, `localai` picks it up through the embedded `OpenAIClient`, and `maxTokensOrDefault` keeps 2048 for an unset or zero value. That matches the `auth add --maxtokens` default of 2048, so existing configs send the same limit as before. The table test covers configured and unset for each backend. CI is green.

Heads-up: #1869 touches the same `ChatCompletionRequest` literal in `pkg/ai/openai.go`, so whichever of the two lands second will need a quick rebase.

Good to merge.
